reason: Verified the quotient model independently: D(L) is a Moebius band, RP^2 is built from it by attaching a disk along the boundary circle, and the resulting quotient is the one-point compactification of the open Moebius band, hence homeomorphic to RP^2; the radial-collapse homeomorphism is checked. Choice-free, and it does not repeat the published mod-two Thom-class example.
